description.en: Vehicle type: Garbage truck Make: Volvo Model: FE320 Year of manufacture: 2017 Starts at the time of documentation: Yes and rolls. Technical data & equipment: Body: NTM Type of loading: Rear loader Number of compartments: 1 LED ramp on the roof Cool box in the cab Central lubrication On Spot Condition & comments: Error code: SA 16 DTCP20EE93 Warns of water in the fuel. Warns of failure in the air suspension. Warns of parking brake while driving. Traces of previous decoration. Defective sealing strip around the front window. Reversing camera out of order. Oil leakage at the deadmans grip and control levers. Manual missing. Damaged front headlights, burnt plastic and cracks. Dented front plastic cover. Two broken mudguards on the passenger side. Damaged side impact protection on the drivers side. Cable winch out of order. Reflectors partially worn away. Crack in container lift. AC out of order. Defective rubber strip around the drivers door. Door stop on the drivers door out of order. Defective door sensor, taped to prevent warning signal. Pictogram on the units controls worn away. Worn step and damaged drivers seat. On Spot out of order. LED ramp out of order. Cooler out of order. Major air leak at the front axle. Brakes: Disc brakes Suspension: Air suspension Tire tread depth: Not over 5 mm Rust, scuffs and scratches are present. See pictures for condition assessment.

valuatorComment.de: Volvo FE320 Müllwagen 2017 NTM Hecklader. ACHTUNG! Dies ist ein stark genutzter LKW und wir empfehlen Ihnen, alle Texte und Schadensfotos sorgfältig zu lesen, um sich ein klares Bild vom Zustand des LKW zu machen. Prüfung gültig bis 28. Feb. 2027.
valuatorComment.en: Volvo FE320 Garbage Truck 2017 NTM Rear Loader. NOTE! This is a worn truck and we encourage you to carefully read all text and damage photos to get a clear picture of the truck's condition. Inspection approved until 28 Feb 2027.
valuatorComment.et: Volvo FE320 Prügiauto 2017 NTM Tagaloader. TÄHELEPANU! Tegemist on kulunud veokiga ning soovitame hoolikalt lugeda kogu teksti ja kahjustuste pilte, et saada selge ülevaade veoki seisukorrast. Kontroll heaks kiidetud kuni 28.veebr 2027.
valuatorComment.fi: Volvo FE320 Jäteauto 2017 NTM Takalastaaja. HUOM! Tämä on kulunut kuorma-auto ja kehotamme sinua lukemaan huolellisesti kaiken tekstin ja vahinkokuvien läpi saadaksesi selkeän kuvan kuorma-auton kunnosta. Katsastus hyväksytty 28. helmikuuta 2027 asti.
valuatorComment.pl: Volvo FE320 Śmieciarka 2017 NTM Załadowarka tylna. UWAGA! To jest zużyta ciężarówka i zachęcamy do dokładnego zapoznania się z całym tekstem i zdjęciami uszkodzeń, aby uzyskać jasny obraz stanu ciężarówki. Przegląd zatwierdzony do 28 lut 2027.
